remarks: In the heart of West Hollywood's Norma Triangle neighborhood, CASA KAYA is an extensively reconstructed residence designed around gathering and indoor-outdoor living. A light-filled great room welcomes you with a vaulted ceiling, skylight, and herringbone engineered wood floors. At the heart of the home, an oversized Dekton island connects to a warm wood dining table, creating a welcoming place to cook, gather, and enjoy conversation. Fully custom cabinetry and ZLINE appliances combine thoughtful design with everyday functionality, while a dramatic 16-foot bifold glass door opens to the deck and backyard shaded by mature trees. A bar with a built-in wine refrigerator and a cozy reading nook
